entries.zh: 到任；就任官职、官员到差任事
entries.en: to take up one's office; to enter upon a Mandarin's post

entries.zh: 赴任；动身前往就任
entries.en: to set out for one's post; to go and take up an office
entries.notes: 首字声调号污损（T99）故降置信；赴任义据汉字与音写 hu-xim 互证明确。

entries.zh: 长选；吏部定期铨选授官（据汉字栏拟释）
entries.en: the regular (long-cycle) selection of officials; to appoint from among those due for office
entries.notes: 西语栏 'tomar mar delos deuen' 不成句，音写 ging/huan 两音节与'長/選'读音均不合，仅据汉字'長選'拟为吏部长选之义，无法互证。

entries.zh: 蘸圣水；蘸取圣水（'溫'依音写当为'揾'蘸义）
entries.en: to dip in holy water; to take holy water (agua bendita)
entries.notes: '溫'依音写 vin 当为'揾'（蘸）之借字；西语 agua bendita 与汉字'圣水'、音写 seng-zui 互证，音写栏尾另缀 chuy' 一音无对应汉字。

entries.zh: 查后手；查账目、追查经手与接手之人（票据之后手）
entries.en: to examine accounts; to trace the successive holders ('latter hands') of a note
entries.notes: 末字声调号污损（T99）故降置信；查后手义据汉字与音写 cha-aun-chiu 互证明确（西语 tomar quentas）。

entries.zh: 撮一把；抓一把、一把撮取
entries.en: to take a handful; to grab a pinch at one go
entries.notes: 首字声调号污损（T99）；撮一把义据汉字与音写 che-chit-pe 互证明确（西语 un puñado）。

entries.zh: 撮起来；用指尖捏撮起来
entries.en: to pick up with the tips of the fingers
entries.notes: 首字声调号污损（T99）；义据西语 tomar con la punta delos dedos 与汉字互证明确。

entries.zh: 撮一撮；捏取一小撮
entries.en: to take a pinch; to pick up a tiny amount with the fingertips
entries.notes: 首末两字声调号污损（T99）；撮一撮义据汉字与音写 che-chit-che 互证明确。

entries.zh: 撮；一小撮（撮取；亦作量词）
entries.en: a pinch; to take up with the fingertips
entries.notes: 次字声调号污损（T99）；据汉字'撮'与音写 chit-che 释义。

entries.zh: 捐起来；征敛捐输归集（西语栏记：官吏取其产、其后更取其份）
entries.en: to collect up levies/contributions; glossed: the Mandarin takes the estate and afterwards a share of it
entries.notes: 音写 chiang 与'捐'（koan）读音不合（或为'將/搶'），西语'官取其产再取其份'与'捐'义有张力，且首字声调号污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 手乱拿（原件作'手乱栅'）；乱拿他人之物、顺手抢取
entries.en: to grab others' property with one's hands indiscriminately; to take what belongs to others
entries.notes: 西语 las ajenas（他人之物）合乱取义，'栅'字疑为'拿/撒'之讹；'por yenvo'不成句（音近'燕窩'或西语 envío，待考），首字声调号污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 出味；渗出味道、有滋味
entries.en: to give out flavor/taste; (of food) to develop its taste
entries.notes: 首字声调号污损（T99）；出味义据汉字与音写 chut-bi 互证明确，西语尾 'alog raue' 不成句。

entries.zh: 翕汗；翕翕汗出、微微出汗
entries.en: to sweat; to break out in a slight sweat (medical '翕翕汗出')
entries.notes: 次字声调号污损（T99）；翕汗（翕，覆也）合西语 tomar sudores（出汗）之义。

entries.zh: 发汗；使出汗、发汗解表（医法）
entries.en: to induce sweating; to sweat (out a fever)

entries.zh: 阴司；阴间官署、掌亡魂簿籍之司
entries.en: the infernal office/court of the dead, keeping account of souls in the other life
entries.notes: 西语栏虽连讹，'la otra vida'（来世）与 tomar quenta（掌簿籍）之义尚明，与汉字'阴司'、音写 im-sy 互证。

entries.zh: 阴府；阴间府署、冥府
entries.en: the netherworld prefecture; the court of the dead

entries.zh: 相带；相就相配（如犬牝牡相就）、两物相连相带
entries.en: (of two) to attach to / pair with each other; (of dogs) to mate; to join two things together
entries.notes: 次字声调号污损（T99）；西语以犬牝牡相就与两物相连并举，合'相带'亲附之义，音写 hua 与'带'不甚合。

entries.zh: 露风；吹风乘凉、露天受风
entries.en: to take the cool air; to expose oneself to the wind

entries.zh: 露冷；受冷吹凉、乘凉着寒
entries.en: to expose oneself to the cold (chilly) air

entries.zh: 露吹风；露立于风中吹拂乘凉
entries.en: to stand exposed to the blowing wind; to take the fresh air

entries.zh: 露吹冷；又'以水淋'（露于吹冷之风，兼以水浇身取凉）
entries.en: to expose oneself to the blowing cold (air); also 'to pour water over oneself' (trailing syllables i-sui-liam without matching characters; uncertain)
entries.notes: 末段音写 'I suy liam' 无对应汉字，拟为'以水淋'（浇身取凉）之说；音写 chin（冷）与本页第19条'露冷'写法相合；末段声调号污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 想乘船；上船〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to want to take ship; to go aboard (damaged entry, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏两读存疑（舡攤/舡欛）、音写栏中段残缺（[残]），仅西语 quiero tomar el navio 与首音 chun（船）明确。
